contributions.statement: In data contracts and specs the agent reads, state the encoding of every default and wildcard explicitly (for example 'empty list means all values'); reversing one such interpretation clause changed 87 of 97 answers in the affected task families.
contributions.evidence: §8.2: seven INTERPRETATION clauses, three resolving ambiguities the manual leaves open; reversing the empty-list clause changes 87/97 payments answers.

contributions.statement: Wrapping a data store in governed tools without documenting what the fields and metrics mean buys little; the documented semantic content is what moves accuracy.
contributions.evidence: Table 4/5 hard split: schema->hollow +5.4/+0.0/+15.1/+14.2; hollow->contract 19.3->55.1, 22.6->56.6, 38.0->68.4, 51.2->77.4 (four models, single runs, one benchmark).
relative_to: retrieval augments context; P04 MCP tool surface

contributions.statement: Never give an agent a write-capable SQL connection for read tasks: without declared rules, competent agents created persistent tables to work around per-call sessions (166 mutating statements, two reached the database); declare forbidden operations in context and enforce them with a statement checker.
contributions.evidence: §7 Table 10: ungoverned arms 166 mutating statements across 26 tasks, governed arms 0 (Fisher p=3e-8 pooled); enforcement layer never fired, so only the declarative half was tested; two real escalations described from transcripts.

reason: A careful hollow-vs-full ablation plus a concrete, non-adversarial mutation mechanism; the interpretation-clause sensitivity is directly relevant to spec-driven development of ingestion contracts. Single benchmark and single runs keep it at moderate.
